data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Mawar means 'abyss' or 'ocean'. This name holds a special significance in Islamic culture as it is mentioned in the Quran when Allah (swt) describes the ocean as being created from His knowledge. The name Mawar carries the meaning “Abyss, Ocean” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mawar usually hope their child will grow to embody abyss, ocean and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mawar total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

The name Mawar could be a fitting and meaningful name for a child born near the sea or for someone whose journey in life is synonymous with the depths and unknowns of the ocean.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name Mawar takes on a deeper meaning, reminding us of Allah's (swt) power, knowledge, and creative ability. The verse from the Quran reminds us of Allah's supreme authority and the limitations of our understanding. This name encourages us to reflect on the greatness of Allah, to have faith in His infinite power, and to walk in obedience to His will.
